<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def dots():
    nodes=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']; out={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==8:
            pts=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
            out[(min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs))]=[nodes[c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
    return out
print('start', dots())
action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','DOWN'])
print('after move', dots(), 'chg=',last_action_result.get('board_changed'),'lvl=',last_action_result.get('level_completed'),'done=',last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def dots():
    nodes=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']; out={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==8:
            pts=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
            out[(min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs))]=[nodes[c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
    return out
print('start', dots())
action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','DOWN'])
print('after move', dots(), 'chg=',last_action_result.get('board_changed'),'lvl=',last_action_result.get('level_completed'),'done=',last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
